scripts.build: bun run build:web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: echo 'Refusing unqualified deploy. Use deploy:tk or deploy:yj-redirect.' >&2; exit 1
scripts.deploy:preview: bun run build:web && wrangler deploy --env preview --profile yj
scripts.deploy:tk: bun run build:web && wrangler deploy --env tk --profile tinkertanker
scripts.deploy:yj-redirect: bun run build:web && wrangler deploy --profile yj
